name: Pumpkin Spice Smoothie with Banana, Almonds & Fresh Ginger
instructions: This recipe will make about 8 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger; place in a blender.
Peel the bananas, break into chunks, and add to the blender.
Add pumpkin purée, almond milk, almonds, maple syrup, spices, and 8 ice cubes to the blender.
Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses. Top with a sprinkle of cinnamon and enjoy!
author: Mealime
